_comment: Drop into ~/.claude/mcp.json (global) or .claude/mcp.json (project). The `-p iris-cc` tells npx that the bin `iris-mcp` lives in the `iris-cc` package; without it, npx would search npm for a package named `iris-mcp` and fail. If iris-cc is already a project-local devDependency, the `-p iris-cc` part is redundant — npx finds the bin in node_modules.
